fields.v: Partly (0.5): online gains over the no-skills baseline are positive in all six pairs as claimed, and mixed offline results, baseline regressions on GPT-5.5 and harmful skill exposure (heavy-tailed effects) are acknowledged; but small gains are presented as consistent without variance or significance testing, and SkillsVote online regressions on the Hard split (e.g. -6.7 pp for GPT-5.2) are not discussed
fields.quote: Offline reuse helps in several settings, but the gains vary across frozen libraries, benchmarks, and backbones.
fields.where: §4.2 Main Results, p. 8; §4.3.2 Recommendation Controls Negative Transfer, p. 9
fields.why: The paper does report mixed and negative results (offline variability, baseline regressions, negative transfer), so No (0) may be too strict; Partly is a defensible reading.
fields.doubt: Os autores reconhecem resultados mistos (ganhos offline variáveis, regressões dos baselines no GPT-5.5, efeito negativo de skills mal escolhidas, pág. 7-9), mas não discutem as perdas no subconjunto Hard. Decide se Q9 fica Não (0) ou Parcial (0,5).
